```{r}
# Section 2
python_bin <- Sys.which("python3")
if (python_bin == "") {
  stop("python3 was not found. Install Python 3 before continuing.")
}
run_python_command <- function(args) {
  out <- system2(
    python_bin,
    args = args,
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )
  status <- attr(out, "status")
  if (is.null(status)) {
    status <- 0L
  }
  list(
    output = out,
    status = status
  )
}
check_cplex <- run_python_command(
  c(
    "-c",
    shQuote("import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)")
  )
)
if (check_cplex$status != 0) {
  cat("Python CPLEX package not found. Attempting installation...\n")
  system2(
    python_bin,
    args = c(
      "-m",
      "pip",
      "install",
      "cplex",
      "docplex"
    )
  )
  check_cplex <- run_python_command(
    c(
      "-c",
      shQuote("import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)")
    )
  )
}
if (check_cplex$status != 0) {
  stop("CPLEX could not be imported into Python.")
}
cat("Using Python:", python_bin, "\n")
cat("CPLEX version:", paste(check_cplex$output, collapse = " "), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Section 3
CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT <- file.path(
  tempdir(),
  "solve_cplex_model_selection_dimensionality_v6.py"
)
python_solver <- c(
  "import sys",
  "import cplex",
  "",
  "lpfile = sys.argv[1]",
  "solfile = sys.argv[2]",
  "time_limit = float(sys.argv[3])",
  "startfile = sys.argv[4]",
  "",
  "problem = cplex.Cplex(lpfile)",
  "",
  "problem.set_log_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_warning_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_results_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_error_stream(None)",
  "",
  "problem.parameters.threads.set(1)",
  "problem.parameters.mip.tolerances.mipgap.set(1e-6)",
  "problem.parameters.emphasis.numerical.set(1)",
  "problem.parameters.mip.strategy.startalgorithm.set(1)",
  "problem.parameters.mip.strategy.subalgorithm.set(1)",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    problem.parameters.clocktype.set(2)",
  "except:",
  "    pass",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    problem.parameters.advance.set(1)",
  "except:",
  "    pass",
  "",
  "if time_limit > 0:",
  "    problem.parameters.timelimit.set(time_limit)",
  "",
  "start_names = []",
  "start_values = []",
  "",
  "with open(startfile, 'r') as f:",
  "    for raw_line in f:",
  "        line = raw_line.strip()",
  "        if not line:",
  "            continue",
  "        parts = line.split('\\t')",
  "        if len(parts) != 2:",
  "            raise ValueError('Invalid warm-start row: ' + line)",
  "        start_names.append(parts[0])",
  "        start_values.append(float(parts[1]))",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    problem.MIP_starts.add(",
  "        cplex.SparsePair(ind=start_names, val=start_values),",
  "        problem.MIP_starts.effort_level.check_feasibility,",
  "        'complete_trivial_feasible_start'",
  "    )",
  "    start_count = problem.MIP_starts.get_num()",
  "    print('MIP_START_ADDED=True')",
  "    print('MIP_START_COUNT=' + str(start_count))",
  "except Exception as exc:",
  "    print('MIP_START_ADDED=False')",
  "    print('MIP_START_COUNT=0')",
  "    print('MIP_START_ERROR=' + str(exc).replace('\\n', ' '))",
  "    sys.exit(3)",
  "",
  "solve_exception = None",
  "try:",
  "    problem.solve()",
  "except cplex.exceptions.CplexSolverError as exc:",
  "    solve_exception = exc",
  "    print('SOLVE_EXCEPTION=' + str(exc).replace('\\n', ' '))",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    feasible = problem.solution.is_primal_feasible()",
  "except:",
  "    feasible = False",
  "",
  "print('PRIMAL_FEASIBLE=' + str(feasible))",
  "",
  "if not feasible:",
  "    sys.exit(2)",
  "",
  "if solve_exception is None:",
  "    status_code = problem.solution.get_status()",
  "    status_string = problem.solution.get_status_string()",
  "else:",
  "    exc_text = str(solve_exception)",
  "    if '3019' in exc_text:",
  "        status_code = -3019",
  "        status_string = 'CPLEX Error 3019; retained primal-feasible incumbent'",
  "    else:",
  "        status_code = -1",
  "        status_string = 'CPLEX solver exception; retained primal-feasible incumbent: ' + exc_text",
  "",
  "print('STATUS_CODE=' + str(status_code))",
  "print('STATUS_STRING=' + str(status_string))",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    objective = problem.solution.get_objective_value()",
  "    print('OBJECTIVE=' + str(objective))",
  "except:",
  "    print('OBJECTIVE=nan')",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    gap = problem.solution.MIP.get_mip_relative_gap()",
  "    print('MIP_GAP=' + str(gap))",
  "except:",
  "    print('MIP_GAP=nan')",
  "",
  "problem.solution.write(solfile)"
)
writeLines(
  python_solver,
  CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
)
cat(
  "Created robust CPLEX solver at:\n",
  CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT,
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 4
best_subset_cplex <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s,
    M = 20,
    time_limit = 300
) {
  n <- nrow(X)
  p <- ncol(X)
  if (s < 1 || s > p) {
    stop("Requested CPLEX cardinality s must satisfy 1 <= s <= p.")
  }
  marginal_scores <- abs(
    as.vector(
      crossprod(X, y)
    )
  )
  warm_support <- sort(
    order(
      marginal_scores,
      decreasing = TRUE
    )[seq_len(s)]
  )
  warm_z <- numeric(p)
  warm_z[warm_support] <- 1
  warm_beta <- numeric(p)
  warm_start_rss <- sum(y^2)
  warm_start_type <-
    "Complete feasible start: selected z, beta=0, residual=y"
  work <- tempfile("cplex_")
  dir.create(work)
  on.exit(
    unlink(work, recursive = TRUE),
    add = TRUE
  )
  lpfile <- file.path(work, "model.lp")
  solfile <- file.path(work, "solution.sol")
  startfile <- file.path(work, "warm_start_complete.txt")
  con <- file(lpfile, "wt")
  writeLines("Minimize", con)
  writeLines(" obj: [", con)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(" + 2 r_%d ^ 2", i),
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(" ] / 2", con)
  writeLines("Subject To", con)
  chunk <- 10
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    starts <- seq(1, p, by = chunk)
    for (cc in seq_along(starts)) {
      start <- starts[cc]
      finish <- min(start + chunk - 1, p)
      txt <- ""
      if (cc == 1) {
        txt <- sprintf(" resid_%d:", i)
      }
      for (j in start:finish) {
        a <- X[i, j]
        if (abs(a) < 1e-14) {
          next
        }
        if (a >= 0) {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(" + %.12g beta_%d", a, j)
          )
        } else {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(" - %.12g beta_%d", -a, j)
          )
        }
      }
      if (finish == p) {
        txt <- paste0(
          txt,
          sprintf(" + r_%d = %.12g", i, y[i])
        )
      }
      writeLines(txt, con)
    }
  }
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " U%d: beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j, j, M, j
      ),
      con
    )
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " L%d: - beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j, j, M, j
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(" card:", con)
  chunk_z <- 25
  for (start in seq(1, p, by = chunk_z)) {
    finish <- min(start + chunk_z - 1, p)
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(" + z_%d", j)
      )
    }
    if (finish == p) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(" = %d", s)
      )
    }
    writeLines(txt, con)
  }
  writeLines("Bounds", con)
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " -%.12g <= beta_%d <= %.12g",
        M, j, M
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(" r_%d free", i),
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines("Binary", con)
  for (start in seq(1, p, by = 25)) {
    finish <- min(start + 24, p)
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(" z_%d", j)
      )
    }
    writeLines(txt, con)
  }
  writeLines("End", con)
  close(con)
  warm_con <- file(startfile, "wt")
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      paste0(
        "beta_", j, "\t",
        sprintf("%.17g", warm_beta[j])
      ),
      warm_con
    )
  }
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      paste0(
        "z_", j, "\t",
        sprintf("%.0f", warm_z[j])
      ),
      warm_con
    )
  }
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      paste0(
        "r_", i, "\t",
        sprintf("%.12g", y[i])
      ),
      warm_con
    )
  }
  close(warm_con)
  solve_start <- proc.time()[3]
  out <- suppressWarnings(
    system2(
      python_bin,
      args = c(
        shQuote(CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT),
        shQuote(lpfile),
        shQuote(solfile),
        as.character(time_limit),
        shQuote(startfile)
      ),
      stdout = TRUE,
      stderr = TRUE
    )
  )
  solve_seconds <- proc.time()[3] - solve_start
  parse_line <- function(prefix) {
    hit <- grep(
      paste0("^", prefix),
      out,
      value = TRUE
    )
    if (length(hit) == 0) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }
    sub(
      paste0("^", prefix),
      "",
      hit[1]
    )
  }
  mip_start_added <- identical(
    parse_line("MIP_START_ADDED="),
    "True"
  )
  mip_start_count <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(
      parse_line("MIP_START_COUNT=")
    )
  )
  if (
    !mip_start_added ||
    is.na(mip_start_count) ||
    mip_start_count < 1
  ) {
    mip_start_error <- parse_line(
      "MIP_START_ERROR="
    )
    stop(
      paste0(
        "CPLEX did not accept the complete feasible MIP start. ",
        ifelse(
          is.na(mip_start_error),
          "No Python error message was returned.",
          mip_start_error
        )
      )
    )
  }
  status_code <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(
      parse_line("STATUS_CODE=")
    )
  )
  status_string <- parse_line(
    "STATUS_STRING="
  )
  mip_gap <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      parse_line("MIP_GAP=")
    )
  )
  solve_exception <- parse_line(
    "SOLVE_EXCEPTION="
  )
  if (!file.exists(solfile)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "CPLEX did not produce a primal-feasible solution. Status: ",
        status_string,
        ". Python output: ",
        paste(out, collapse = " | ")
      )
    )
  }
  sol <- readLines(
    solfile,
    warn = FALSE
  )
  beta <- numeric(p)
  z <- numeric(p)
  for (line in sol) {
    if (!grepl("<variable", line, fixed = TRUE)) {
      next
    }
    name_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'name="([^"]+)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (length(name_match) != 2) {
      next
    }
    name <- name_match[2]
    value_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'value="([-+]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (length(value_match) != 2) {
      next
    }
    value <- as.numeric(
      value_match[2]
    )
    if (grepl("^beta_[0-9]+$", name)) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub("^beta_", "", name)
      )
      if (!is.na(j) && j <= p) {
        beta[j] <- value
      }
    }
    if (grepl("^z_[0-9]+$", name)) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub("^z_", "", name)
      )
      if (!is.na(j) && j <= p) {
        z[j] <- value
      }
    }
  }
  selected <- which(z > 0.5)
  rss <- sum(
    (
      y -
        as.vector(
          X %*% beta
        )
    )^2
  )
  max_abs_beta <- max(abs(beta))
  feasible_incumbent <- TRUE
  certified_optimal <-
    !is.na(status_code) &&
    status_code %in% c(101L, 102L)
  recovered_numerical_error <-
    !is.na(status_code) &&
    status_code == -3019L
  list(
    beta = beta,
    selected = selected,
    rss = rss,
    status_code = status_code,
    status = status_string,
    mip_gap = mip_gap,
    solve_seconds = solve_seconds,
    max_abs_beta = max_abs_beta,
    feasible_incumbent = feasible_incumbent,
    certified_optimal = certified_optimal,
    reference_eligible = feasible_incumbent,
    warm_start_added = mip_start_added,
    warm_start_count = mip_start_count,
    warm_start_support = warm_support,
    warm_start_rss = warm_start_rss,
    warm_start_type = warm_start_type,
    solve_exception = solve_exception,
    recovered_numerical_error = recovered_numerical_error,
    cplex_output = out
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 6
generate_replication_base <- function(
    rep_id,
    n,
    p_min,
    p_max,
    rho,
    s_true,
    beta_min,
    beta_max,
    target_snr,
    master_seed
) {
  set.seed(master_seed + rep_id)
  common_factor <- rnorm(n)
  Z <- matrix(
    rnorm(n * p_max),
    nrow = n,
    ncol = p_max
  )
  X_raw_max <-
    sqrt(rho) *
      matrix(
        common_factor,
        nrow = n,
        ncol = p_max
      ) +
    sqrt(1 - rho) * Z
  true_support <- sort(
    sample(
      seq_len(p_min),
      size = s_true,
      replace = FALSE
    )
  )
  magnitudes <- runif(
    s_true,
    min = beta_min,
    max = beta_max
  )
  signs <- sample(
    c(-1, 1),
    size = s_true,
    replace = TRUE
  )
  beta_values <- signs * magnitudes
  beta_full <- numeric(p_max)
  beta_full[true_support] <- beta_values
  Sigma_rho <-
    (1 - rho) * diag(p_max) +
    rho * matrix(
      1,
      nrow = p_max,
      ncol = p_max
    )
  population_signal_variance <- as.numeric(
    t(beta_full) %*%
      Sigma_rho %*%
      beta_full
  )
  sigma_sq <-
    population_signal_variance /
    target_snr
  sigma <- sqrt(sigma_sq)
  epsilon_base <- rnorm(n)
  epsilon <- sigma * epsilon_base
  signal_raw <- as.vector(
    X_raw_max %*%
      beta_full
  )
  y_raw <- signal_raw + epsilon
  list(
    X_raw_max = X_raw_max,
    y_raw = y_raw,
    signal_raw = signal_raw,
    epsilon = epsilon,
    beta_full = beta_full,
    true_support = true_support,
    population_signal_variance =
      population_signal_variance,
    sigma_sq = sigma_sq,
    sigma = sigma,
    population_snr_check =
      population_signal_variance /
      sigma_sq,
    realised_snr =
      var(signal_raw) /
      var(epsilon)
  )
}
make_dimension_dataset <- function(
    base,
    p_current
) {
  X_raw <- base$X_raw_max[
    ,
    seq_len(p_current),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  X <- as.matrix(
    scale(
      X_raw,
      center = TRUE,
      scale = TRUE
    )
  )
  colnames(X) <- paste0(
    "X",
    seq_len(p_current)
  )
  y <- as.numeric(
    base$y_raw -
      mean(base$y_raw)
  )
  beta_true <- base$beta_full[
    seq_len(p_current)
  ]
  list(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    X_raw = X_raw,
    y_raw = base$y_raw,
    beta_true = beta_true,
    true_support = base$true_support,
    p = p_current,
    target_snr = target_snr,
    population_signal_variance =
      base$population_signal_variance,
    sigma_sq = base$sigma_sq,
    sigma = base$sigma,
    population_snr_check =
      base$population_snr_check,
    realised_snr =
      base$realised_snr
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 7
atomic_save_rds <- function(
    object,
    path
) {
  directory <- dirname(path)
  if (!dir.exists(directory)) {
    dir.create(
      directory,
      recursive = TRUE,
      showWarnings = FALSE
    )
  }
  tmp_path <- tempfile(
    pattern = paste0(
      ".",
      basename(path),
      "_tmp_"
    ),
    tmpdir = directory
  )
  backup_path <- paste0(path, ".bak")
  saveRDS(
    object,
    tmp_path,
    compress = FALSE
  )
  if (
    !file.exists(tmp_path) ||
    is.na(file.info(tmp_path)$size) ||
    file.info(tmp_path)$size <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Temporary checkpoint write failed:",
        tmp_path
      )
    )
  }
  invisible(readRDS(tmp_path))
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    if (file.exists(backup_path)) {
      unlink(backup_path)
    }
    backup_ok <- file.rename(
      path,
      backup_path
    )
    if (!backup_ok) {
      backup_ok <- file.copy(
        path,
        backup_path,
        overwrite = TRUE
      )
      if (!backup_ok) {
        unlink(tmp_path)
        stop(
          paste(
            "Could not back up existing checkpoint:",
            path
          )
        )
      }
      unlink(path)
    }
  }
  commit_ok <- file.rename(
    tmp_path,
    path
  )
  if (!commit_ok) {
    commit_ok <- file.copy(
      tmp_path,
      path,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )
    unlink(tmp_path)
  }
  if (!commit_ok) {
    if (
      !file.exists(path) &&
      file.exists(backup_path)
    ) {
      file.copy(
        backup_path,
        path,
        overwrite = TRUE
      )
    }
    stop(
      paste(
        "Could not commit checkpoint to:",
        path
      )
    )
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
read_checkpoint_safely <- function(
    path
) {
  backup_path <- paste0(path, ".bak")
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (file.exists(backup_path)) {
      warning(
        "Primary checkpoint is absent; loading the .bak checkpoint."
      )
      return(readRDS(backup_path))
    }
    return(NULL)
  }
  tryCatch(
    readRDS(path),
    error = function(e) {
      if (file.exists(backup_path)) {
        warning(
          paste(
            "Primary checkpoint could not be read; using backup:",
            conditionMessage(e)
          )
        )
        return(readRDS(backup_path))
      }
      stop(
        paste(
          "Checkpoint could not be read and no backup exists:",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )
      )
    }
  )
}
ols_refit <- function(
    X,
    y,
    support
) {
  support <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(support)
    )
  )
  p <- ncol(X)
  if (length(support) == 0) {
    return(
      list(
        beta = numeric(p),
        fitted = rep(0, length(y)),
        rss = sum(y^2)
      )
    )
  }
  Xs <- X[
    ,
    support,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = Xs,
    y = y
  )
  if (
    any(
      !is.finite(
        fit$coefficients
      )
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      "OLS refit produced non-finite coefficients."
    )
  }
  beta <- numeric(p)
  beta[support] <- fit$coefficients
  fitted <- as.vector(
    X %*% beta
  )
  rss <- sum(
    (y - fitted)^2
  )
  list(
    beta = beta,
    fitted = fitted,
    rss = rss
  )
}
support_key <- function(
    support
) {
  if (length(support) == 0) {
    return("")
  }
  paste(
    sort(support),
    collapse = ","
  )
}
safe_model_fit <- function(
    fit_function,
    model_size,
    ...
) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      ans <- fit_function(...)
      ans$success <- TRUE
      ans$error <- NA_character_
      ans$k <- model_size
      ans
    },
    error = function(e) {
      list(
        success = FALSE,
        error = conditionMessage(e),
        k = model_size,
        support = integer(0),
        beta = numeric(0),
        fitted = numeric(0),
        rss = NA_real_,
        runtime = NA_real_,
        status = NA_character_,
        status_code = NA_integer_,
        mip_gap = NA_real_,
        feasible_incumbent = FALSE,
        certified_optimal = FALSE,
        warm_start_added = FALSE,
        warm_start_support = integer(0),
        warm_start_rss = NA_real_,
        warm_start_type = NA_character_,
        solve_exception = NA_character_,
        recovered_numerical_error = FALSE,
        diagnostic_eligible = FALSE,
        cardinality_source = NA_character_
      )
    }
  )
}
model_is_diagnostic_eligible <- function(
    model
) {
  if (is.null(model$diagnostic_eligible)) {
    return(TRUE)
  }
  isTRUE(model$diagnostic_eligible)
}
```

```{r}
fit_cplex_model <- function(
    X,
    y,
    k,
    M,
    time_limit
) {
  start_time <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- best_subset_cplex(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    s = k,
    M = M,
    time_limit = time_limit
  )
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time
  support <- sort(
    as.integer(
      fit$selected
    )
  )
  if (length(support) != k) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "CPLEX returned",
        length(support),
        "selected variables when k =",
        k
      )
    )
  }
  refit <- ols_refit(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    support = support
  )
  list(
    support = support,
    beta = refit$beta,
    fitted = refit$fitted,
    rss = refit$rss,
    runtime = runtime,
    status = fit$status,
    status_code = fit$status_code,
    mip_gap = fit$mip_gap,
    max_abs_beta = fit$max_abs_beta,
    feasible_incumbent =
      fit$feasible_incumbent,
    certified_optimal =
      fit$certified_optimal,
    warm_start_added =
      fit$warm_start_added,
    warm_start_support =
      fit$warm_start_support,
    warm_start_rss =
      fit$warm_start_rss,
    warm_start_type =
      fit$warm_start_type,
    solve_exception =
      fit$solve_exception,
    recovered_numerical_error =
      fit$recovered_numerical_error,
    diagnostic_eligible =
      fit$reference_eligible,
    cardinality_source = "Exact"
  )
}
fit_combss_model <- function(
    X,
    y,
    k
) {
  start_time <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- combss::combss(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    family = "gaussian",
    q = k,
    lam_ridge = 0,
    Niter = 100,
    alpha = 0.1,
    scale = FALSE,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time
  if (length(fit$subset_list) < k) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "COMBSS did not return model size",
        k
      )
    )
  }
  support <- sort(
    as.integer(
      fit$subset_list[[k]]
    )
  )
  if (length(support) != k) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "COMBSS returned",
        length(support),
        "predictors when k =",
        k
      )
    )
  }
  refit <- ols_refit(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    support = support
  )
  list(
    support = support,
    beta = refit$beta,
    fitted = refit$fitted,
    rss = refit$rss,
    runtime = runtime,
    status = NA_character_,
    status_code = NA_integer_,
    mip_gap = NA_real_,
    diagnostic_eligible = TRUE,
    cardinality_source = "Exact"
  )
}
fit_abess_path <- function(
    X,
    y,
    k_values
) {
  total_start <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- abess::abess(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    family = "gaussian",
    tune.path = "sequence",
    support.size = k_values,
    tune.type = "gic",
    lambda = 0,
    normalize = 0,
    fit.intercept = FALSE,
    early.stop = FALSE,
    warm.start = TRUE,
    num.threads = 1
  )
  models <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(k_values)
  )
  for (ii in seq_along(k_values)) {
    k <- k_values[ii]
    model <- abess::extract(
      fit,
      support.size = k
    )
    beta_hat <- as.numeric(
      model$beta
    )
    support <- sort(
      which(
        abs(beta_hat) >
          1e-10
      )
    )
    if (length(support) != k) {
      stop(
        paste(
          "ABESS returned",
          length(support),
          "predictors when k =",
          k
        )
      )
    }
    refit <- ols_refit(
      X = X,
      y = y,
      support = support
    )
    models[[ii]] <- list(
      success = TRUE,
      error = NA_character_,
      k = k,
      support = support,
      beta = refit$beta,
      fitted = refit$fitted,
      rss = refit$rss,
      runtime = NA_real_,
      status = NA_character_,
      status_code = NA_integer_,
      mip_gap = NA_real_,
      diagnostic_eligible = TRUE,
      cardinality_source = "Exact"
    )
  }
  total_runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    total_start
  best_model <- abess::extract(fit)
  gic_size_native <- as.integer(
    best_model$support.size
  )
  n_local <- nrow(X)
  p_local <- ncol(X)
  manual_gic <- vapply(
    models,
    function(model) {
      n_local *
        log(
          model$rss /
            n_local
        ) +
        model$k *
          log(p_local) *
          log(
            log(n_local)
          )
    },
    numeric(1)
  )
  gic_size_manual <-
    k_values[
      which.min(manual_gic)
    ]
  list(
    success = TRUE,
    models = models,
    path_runtime = total_runtime,
    gic_size_native = gic_size_native,
    gic_size_manual =
      as.integer(gic_size_manual),
    gic_match =
      gic_size_native ==
      as.integer(gic_size_manual),
    error = NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 9
fit_l0learn_path <- function(
    X,
    y,
    max_support,
    grid_points = 1200,
    upper_multiplier = 2,
    lower_multiplier = 0.02,
    refine_points_per_gap = 100,
    refine_rounds = 2
) {
  total_start <- proc.time()[3]
  max_support <- min(
    max_support,
    ncol(X)
  )
  pilot_fit <- L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    loss = "SquaredError",
    penalty = "L0",
    algorithm = "CD",
    maxSuppSize = max_support,
    nLambda = 100,
    scaleDownFactor = 0.80,
    screenSize = ncol(X),
    intercept = FALSE
  )
  pilot_lambda <- as.numeric(
    pilot_fit$lambda[[1]]
  )
  pilot_lambda <- pilot_lambda[
    is.finite(pilot_lambda) &
      pilot_lambda > 0
  ]
  if (length(pilot_lambda) < 2) {
    stop(
      "L0Learn pilot path did not produce a usable lambda range."
    )
  }
  lambda_upper <-
    max(pilot_lambda) *
    upper_multiplier
  lambda_lower <-
    min(pilot_lambda) *
    lower_multiplier
  lambda_grid <- exp(
    seq(
      from = log(lambda_upper),
      to = log(lambda_lower),
      length.out = grid_points
    )
  )
  run_cdpsi <- function(
      lambda_values
  ) {
    L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
      x = X,
      y = y,
      loss = "SquaredError",
      penalty = "L0",
      algorithm = "CDPSI",
      maxSuppSize = max_support,
      lambdaGrid = list(lambda_values),
      partialSort = TRUE,
      maxIters = 200,
      rtol = 1e-6,
      atol = 1e-9,
      activeSet = TRUE,
      activeSetNum = 3,
      maxSwaps = 100,
      screenSize = ncol(X),
      intercept = FALSE
    )
  }
  fit <- run_cdpsi(
    lambda_grid
  )
  refinement_rounds_used <- 0
  if (refine_rounds > 0) {
    for (rr in seq_len(refine_rounds)) {
      fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
        fit$lambda[[1]]
      )
      support_sizes <- as.integer(
        fit$suppSize[[1]]
      )
      ord <- order(
        fitted_lambda,
        decreasing = TRUE
      )
      lambda_ordered <-
        fitted_lambda[ord]
      size_ordered <-
        support_sizes[ord]
      gap_indices <- which(
        abs(
          diff(size_ordered)
        ) > 1
      )
      if (length(gap_indices) == 0) {
        break
      }
      extra_lambda <- numeric(0)
      for (i in gap_indices) {
        upper <- max(
          lambda_ordered[i],
          lambda_ordered[i + 1]
        )
        lower <- min(
          lambda_ordered[i],
          lambda_ordered[i + 1]
        )
        if (
          is.finite(upper) &&
          is.finite(lower) &&
          lower > 0 &&
          upper > lower
        ) {
          local_grid <- exp(
            seq(
              from = log(upper),
              to = log(lower),
              length.out =
                refine_points_per_gap + 2
            )
          )
          local_grid <- local_grid[
            -c(
              1,
              length(local_grid)
            )
          ]
          extra_lambda <- c(
            extra_lambda,
            local_grid
          )
        }
      }
      if (length(extra_lambda) == 0) {
        break
      }
      new_lambda_grid <- sort(
        unique(
          c(
            lambda_grid,
            extra_lambda
          )
        ),
        decreasing = TRUE
      )
      if (
        length(new_lambda_grid) ==
        length(lambda_grid)
      ) {
        break
      }
      lambda_grid <- new_lambda_grid
      refinement_rounds_used <- rr
      fit <- run_cdpsi(
        lambda_grid
      )
    }
  }
  support_sizes <- as.integer(
    fit$suppSize[[1]]
  )
  fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
    fit$lambda[[1]]
  )
  beta_path <- as.matrix(
    fit$beta[[1]]
  )
  candidate_sizes <- sort(
    unique(
      support_sizes[
        support_sizes >= 1 &
        support_sizes <= max_support
      ]
    )
  )
  models <- list()
  model_counter <- 1
  for (k in candidate_sizes) {
    candidate_indices <- which(
      support_sizes == k
    )
    valid_supports <- list()
    valid_refits <- list()
    valid_lambda <- numeric(0)
    valid_rss <- numeric(0)
    valid_counter <- 1
    for (index in candidate_indices) {
      beta_j <- beta_path[
        ,
        index
      ]
      support_j <- sort(
        which(
          abs(beta_j) >
            1e-10
        )
      )
      if (length(support_j) != k) {
        next
      }
      refit_j <- ols_refit(
        X = X,
        y = y,
        support = support_j
      )
      valid_supports[[valid_counter]] <-
        support_j
      valid_refits[[valid_counter]] <-
        refit_j
      valid_lambda[valid_counter] <-
        fitted_lambda[index]
      valid_rss[valid_counter] <-
        refit_j$rss
      valid_counter <-
        valid_counter + 1
    }
    if (length(valid_rss) == 0) {
      next
    }
    best_candidate <- which.min(
      valid_rss
    )
    best_refit <- valid_refits[[
      best_candidate
    ]]
    models[[model_counter]] <- list(
      success = TRUE,
      error = NA_character_,
      k = k,
      support =
        valid_supports[[best_candidate]],
      beta = best_refit$beta,
      fitted = best_refit$fitted,
      rss = best_refit$rss,
      selected_lambda =
        valid_lambda[best_candidate],
      runtime = NA_real_,
      status = NA_character_,
      status_code = NA_integer_,
      mip_gap = NA_real_,
      diagnostic_eligible = TRUE,
      cardinality_source = "Native"
    )
    model_counter <-
      model_counter + 1
  }
  if (length(models) == 0) {
    stop(
      "L0Learn produced no usable positive-cardinality models."
    )
  }
  model_sizes <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      x$k
    },
    integer(1)
  )
  ord <- order(model_sizes)
  models <- models[ord]
  available_sizes <- sort(
    vapply(
      models,
      function(x) {
        x$k
      },
      integer(1)
    )
  )
  total_runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    total_start
  list(
    success = TRUE,
    models = models,
    path_runtime = total_runtime,
    available_sizes = available_sizes,
    missing_sizes =
      setdiff(
        seq_len(max_support),
        available_sizes
      ),
    number_distinct_sizes =
      length(available_sizes),
    refinement_rounds =
      refinement_rounds_used,
    number_lambda_values =
      length(fitted_lambda),
    error = NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 10
fit_fixed_path <- function(
    method,
    X,
    y,
    k_values,
    cplex_time_limit = 300
) {
  models <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(k_values)
  )
  for (ii in seq_along(k_values)) {
    k <- k_values[ii]
    cat(
      "      ",
      method,
      " k = ",
      k,
      "\n",
      sep = ""
    )
    if (method == "CPLEX") {
      model <- safe_model_fit(
        fit_cplex_model,
        model_size = k,
        X = X,
        y = y,
        k = k,
        M = big_M,
        time_limit =
          cplex_time_limit
      )
    } else if (method == "COMBSS") {
      model <- safe_model_fit(
        fit_combss_model,
        model_size = k,
        X = X,
        y = y,
        k = k
      )
    } else {
      stop("Unknown fixed-path method.")
    }
    models[[ii]] <- model
  }
  successful <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      isTRUE(x$success)
    },
    logical(1)
  )
  runtimes <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      if (is.null(x$runtime)) {
        return(NA_real_)
      }
      x$runtime
    },
    numeric(1)
  )
  path_runtime <-
    if (all(is.na(runtimes))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(
        runtimes,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
  list(
    success = all(successful),
    models = models,
    path_runtime = path_runtime,
    error =
      if (all(successful)) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        "At least one fixed-size model failed."
      }
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 11
fit_linear_segment <- function(
    x,
    y
) {
  design <- cbind(
    1,
    x
  )
  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = design,
    y = y
  )
  coefficients <- fit$coefficients
  fitted <- as.vector(
    design %*% coefficients
  )
  residuals <- y - fitted
  list(
    intercept = coefficients[1],
    slope = coefficients[2],
    fitted = fitted,
    sse = sum(residuals^2)
  )
}
piecewise_breakpoint <- function(
    k,
    z,
    min_left = 2,
    min_right = 2
) {
  valid <-
    is.finite(k) &
    is.finite(z)
  k <- k[valid]
  z <- z[valid]
  ord <- order(k)
  k <- k[ord]
  z <- z[ord]
  m <- length(k)
  if (
    m <
    min_left +
    min_right
  ) {
    return(
      list(
        success = FALSE,
        breakpoint_after_k = NA_integer_,
        s_hat = NA_integer_,
        total_sse = NA_real_,
        fitted = rep(NA_real_, m),
        segment = rep(NA_character_, m)
      )
    )
  }
  candidate_indices <- seq(
    from = min_left,
    to = m - min_right
  )
  total_sse <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(candidate_indices)
  )
  for (ii in seq_along(candidate_indices)) {
    split_index <-
      candidate_indices[ii]
    left_index <- seq_len(
      split_index
    )
    right_index <- seq(
      split_index + 1,
      m
    )
    left_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
      x = k[left_index],
      y = z[left_index]
    )
    right_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
      x = k[right_index],
      y = z[right_index]
    )
    total_sse[ii] <-
      left_fit$sse +
      right_fit$sse
  }
  best_candidate <- which.min(
    total_sse
  )
  split_index <-
    candidate_indices[
      best_candidate
    ]
  left_index <- seq_len(
    split_index
  )
  right_index <- seq(
    split_index + 1,
    m
  )
  left_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
    x = k[left_index],
    y = z[left_index]
  )
  right_fit <- fit_linear_segment(
    x = k[right_index],
    y = z[right_index]
  )
  fitted_piecewise <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    m
  )
  fitted_piecewise[left_index] <-
    left_fit$fitted
  fitted_piecewise[right_index] <-
    right_fit$fitted
  segment <- rep(
    NA_character_,
    m
  )
  segment[left_index] <- "Left"
  segment[right_index] <- "Right"
  breakpoint_after_k <-
    k[split_index]
  s_hat <-
    breakpoint_after_k + 1L
  list(
    success = TRUE,
    breakpoint_after_k =
      as.integer(breakpoint_after_k),
    s_hat = as.integer(s_hat),
    total_sse =
      total_sse[best_candidate],
    fitted = fitted_piecewise,
    segment = segment,
    left_intercept =
      left_fit$intercept,
    left_slope =
      left_fit$slope,
    right_intercept =
      right_fit$intercept,
    right_slope =
      right_fit$slope
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 12
diagnose_model_path <- function(
    path,
    n,
    p,
    required_reference_k,
    required_k_values = NULL,
    require_complete_path = FALSE,
    ratio_floor = 1e-16,
    min_left = 2,
    min_right = 2
) {
  failure <- function(reason) {
    list(
      threshold_available = FALSE,
      threshold_hat = NA_integer_,
      piecewise_available = FALSE,
      piecewise_hat = NA_integer_,
      breakpoint_after_k = NA_integer_,
      breakpoint_sse = NA_real_,
      reference_k = NA_integer_,
      sigma_hat_sq = NA_real_,
      curve = NULL,
      failure_reason = reason
    )
  }
  if (
    is.null(path$models) ||
    length(path$models) == 0
  ) {
    return(
      failure(
        "No fitted model path was available."
      )
    )
  }
  valid_model <- vapply(
    path$models,
    function(x) {
      isTRUE(x$success) &&
      is.finite(x$rss) &&
      length(x$fitted) == n &&
      model_is_diagnostic_eligible(x)
    },
    logical(1)
  )
  models <- path$models[
    valid_model
  ]
  if (length(models) == 0) {
    return(
      failure(
        "No eligible fitted models were available."
      )
    )
  }
  model_k <- vapply(
    models,
    function(x) {
      as.integer(x$k)
    },
    integer(1)
  )
  ord <- order(model_k)
  models <- models[ord]
  model_k <- model_k[ord]
  if (require_complete_path) {
    missing_required <- setdiff(
      required_k_values,
      model_k
    )
    if (length(missing_required) > 0) {
      return(
        failure(
          paste(
            "Complete eligible path unavailable. Missing k:",
            paste(
              missing_required,
              collapse = ", "
            )
          )
        )
      )
    }
  }
  reference_match <- which(
    model_k ==
    required_reference_k
  )
  if (length(reference_match) != 1) {
    return(
      failure(
        paste(
          "Eligible reference model k =",
          required_reference_k,
          "was not available."
        )
      )
    )
  }
  keep <-
    model_k <=
    required_reference_k
  models <- models[keep]
  model_k <- model_k[keep]
  reference_index <- which(
    model_k ==
    required_reference_k
  )
  reference_model <- models[[
    reference_index
  ]]
  reference_k <-
    required_reference_k
  fitted_reference <-
    reference_model$fitted
  rss_reference <-
    reference_model$rss
  sigma_hat_sq <-
    rss_reference /
    (n - reference_k)
  if (
    !is.finite(sigma_hat_sq) ||
    sigma_hat_sq <= 0
  ) {
    return(
      failure(
        "Reference-model variance estimate was invalid."
      )
    )
  }
  score <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(models)
  )
  level <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(models)
  )
  ratio <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(models)
  )
  for (ii in seq_along(models)) {
    model <- models[[ii]]
    k_i <- model$k
    score[ii] <- sum(
      (
        model$fitted -
        fitted_reference
      )^2
    )
    level[ii] <-
      4 *
      (
        sqrt(k_i) +
        sqrt(reference_k)
      )^2 *
      (
        2 * log(p) +
        log(n) +
        1
      ) *
      sigma_hat_sq
    ratio[ii] <-
      score[ii] /
      level[ii]
  }
  curve <- data.frame(
    k = model_k,
    score = score,
    level = level,
    ratio = ratio,
    is_reference =
      model_k ==
      reference_k,
    used_in_piecewise =
      model_k <
      reference_k,
    log10_ratio = NA_real_,
    piecewise_fit = NA_real_,
    piecewise_segment = NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  qualifying <- curve$k[
    is.finite(curve$ratio) &
    curve$k < reference_k &
    curve$ratio <= 1
  ]
  threshold_hat <-
    if (length(qualifying) > 0) {
      min(qualifying)
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  threshold_available <-
    !is.na(threshold_hat)
  piecewise_indices <- which(
    curve$k <
    reference_k
  )
  piecewise_k <- curve$k[
    piecewise_indices
  ]
  piecewise_ratio <- curve$ratio[
    piecewise_indices
  ]
  piecewise_z <- log10(
    pmax(
      piecewise_ratio,
      ratio_floor
    )
  )
  curve$log10_ratio[
    piecewise_indices
  ] <- piecewise_z
  breakpoint <- piecewise_breakpoint(
    k = piecewise_k,
    z = piecewise_z,
    min_left = min_left,
    min_right = min_right
  )
  piecewise_available <-
    isTRUE(breakpoint$success)
  piecewise_hat <-
    if (piecewise_available) {
      breakpoint$s_hat
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  breakpoint_after_k <-
    if (piecewise_available) {
      breakpoint$breakpoint_after_k
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  if (piecewise_available) {
    curve$piecewise_fit[
      piecewise_indices
    ] <- breakpoint$fitted
    curve$piecewise_segment[
      piecewise_indices
    ] <- breakpoint$segment
  }
  list(
    threshold_available =
      threshold_available,
    threshold_hat =
      threshold_hat,
    piecewise_available =
      piecewise_available,
    piecewise_hat =
      piecewise_hat,
    breakpoint_after_k =
      breakpoint_after_k,
    breakpoint_sse =
      if (piecewise_available) {
        breakpoint$total_sse
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    reference_k =
      reference_k,
    sigma_hat_sq =
      sigma_hat_sq,
    curve =
      curve,
    failure_reason =
      NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 13
path_to_table <- function(
    path,
    rep_id,
    p_current,
    method
) {
  if (
    is.null(path$models) ||
    length(path$models) == 0
  ) {
    return(data.frame())
  }
  rows <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = length(path$models)
  )
  for (ii in seq_along(path$models)) {
    model <- path$models[[ii]]
    rows[[ii]] <- data.frame(
      rep = rep_id,
      p = p_current,
      method = method,
      k = model$k,
      success =
        isTRUE(model$success),
      diagnostic_eligible =
        model_is_diagnostic_eligible(model),
      feasible_incumbent =
        if (
          is.null(model$feasible_incumbent) ||
          length(model$feasible_incumbent) == 0
        ) {
          NA
        } else {
          model$feasible_incumbent
        },
      certified_optimal =
        if (
          is.null(model$certified_optimal) ||
          length(model$certified_optimal) == 0
        ) {
          NA
        } else {
          model$certified_optimal
        },
      warm_start_added =
        if (
          is.null(model$warm_start_added) ||
          length(model$warm_start_added) == 0
        ) {
          NA
        } else {
          model$warm_start_added
        },
      warm_start_support =
        if (
          is.null(model$warm_start_support) ||
          length(model$warm_start_support) == 0
        ) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          support_key(
            model$warm_start_support
          )
        },
      warm_start_rss =
        if (
          is.null(model$warm_start_rss) ||
          length(model$warm_start_rss) == 0
        ) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          model$warm_start_rss
        },
      warm_start_type =
        if (
          is.null(model$warm_start_type) ||
          length(model$warm_start_type) == 0
        ) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          model$warm_start_type
        },
      recovered_numerical_error =
        if (
          is.null(model$recovered_numerical_error) ||
          length(model$recovered_numerical_error) == 0
        ) {
          NA
        } else {
          model$recovered_numerical_error
        },
      solve_exception =
        if (
          is.null(model$solve_exception) ||
          length(model$solve_exception) == 0
        ) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          model$solve_exception
        },
      support =
        if (isTRUE(model$success)) {
          support_key(model$support)
        } else {
          NA_character_
        },
      rss = model$rss,
      runtime =
        if (is.null(model$runtime)) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          model$runtime
        },
      path_runtime =
        path$path_runtime,
      cplex_status =
        if (is.null(model$status)) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          model$status
        },
      cplex_status_code =
        if (is.null(model$status_code)) {
          NA_integer_
        } else {
          model$status_code
        },
      cplex_gap =
        if (is.null(model$mip_gap)) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          model$mip_gap
        },
      cardinality_source =
        if (
          is.null(model$cardinality_source)
        ) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          model$cardinality_source
        },
      error =
        if (is.null(model$error)) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          model$error
        },
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
}
make_identification_row <- function(
    rep_id,
    p_current,
    method,
    estimator,
    s_hat,
    path_runtime = NA_real_,
    reference_k = NA_integer_,
    failure_reason = NA_character_
) {
  estimate_available <-
    !is.na(s_hat)
  data.frame(
    rep = rep_id,
    p = p_current,
    s_true = s_true,
    method = method,
    estimator = estimator,
    s_hat =
      if (estimate_available) {
        as.integer(s_hat)
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },
    estimate_available =
      estimate_available,
    correct =
      if (estimate_available) {
        s_hat == s_true
      } else {
        FALSE
      },
    absolute_error =
      if (estimate_available) {
        abs(s_hat - s_true)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    signed_error =
      if (estimate_available) {
        s_hat - s_true
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    reference_k =
      reference_k,
    path_runtime =
      path_runtime,
    failure_reason =
      failure_reason,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
diagnostic_identification_rows <- function(
    diagnostic,
    rep_id,
    p_current,
    method,
    path_runtime
) {
  threshold_reason <-
    if (diagnostic$threshold_available) {
      NA_character_
    } else if (
      !is.null(diagnostic$failure_reason) &&
      !is.na(diagnostic$failure_reason)
    ) {
      diagnostic$failure_reason
    } else {
      "No threshold crossing before k_max."
    }
  piecewise_reason <-
    if (diagnostic$piecewise_available) {
      NA_character_
    } else if (
      !is.null(diagnostic$failure_reason) &&
      !is.na(diagnostic$failure_reason)
    ) {
      diagnostic$failure_reason
    } else {
      "Piecewise breakpoint unavailable."
    }
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    make_identification_row(
      rep_id = rep_id,
      p_current = p_current,
      method = method,
      estimator = "Threshold",
      s_hat = diagnostic$threshold_hat,
      path_runtime = path_runtime,
      reference_k =
        diagnostic$reference_k,
      failure_reason =
        threshold_reason
    ),
    make_identification_row(
      rep_id = rep_id,
      p_current = p_current,
      method = method,
      estimator = "Breakpoint",
      s_hat = diagnostic$piecewise_hat,
      path_runtime = path_runtime,
      reference_k =
        diagnostic$reference_k,
      failure_reason =
        piecewise_reason
    )
  )
}
diagnostic_curve_table <- function(
    diagnostic,
    rep_id,
    p_current,
    method
) {
  if (is.null(diagnostic$curve)) {
    return(data.frame())
  }
  diagnostic$curve %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rep = rep_id,
      p = p_current,
      method = method,
      threshold_hat =
        diagnostic$threshold_hat,
      piecewise_hat =
        diagnostic$piecewise_hat,
      breakpoint_after_k =
        diagnostic$breakpoint_after_k,
      reference_k =
        diagnostic$reference_k
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      rep,
      p,
      method,
      k,
      score,
      level,
      ratio,
      log10_ratio,
      is_reference,
      used_in_piecewise,
      piecewise_fit,
      piecewise_segment,
      threshold_hat,
      piecewise_hat,
      breakpoint_after_k,
      reference_k
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 14
preflight_base <- generate_replication_base(
  rep_id = 1,
  n = n,
  p_min = p_min,
  p_max = p_max,
  rho = rho,
  s_true = s_true,
  beta_min = beta_min,
  beta_max = beta_max,
  target_snr = target_snr,
  master_seed = master_seed
)
preflight_p_values <- c(
  125,
  200
)
preflight_time_limit <- 5
for (preflight_p in preflight_p_values) {
  preflight_data <- make_dimension_dataset(
    base = preflight_base,
    p_current = preflight_p
  )
  cat(
    "\nRunning mandatory CPLEX all-k preflight at p =",
    preflight_p,
    "...\n"
  )
  preflight_rows <- vector(
    "list",
    length(k_values)
  )
  for (ii in seq_along(k_values)) {
    preflight_k <- k_values[ii]
    cat(
      "  preflight k =",
      preflight_k,
      "\n"
    )
    preflight_fit <- safe_model_fit(
      fit_cplex_model,
      model_size = preflight_k,
      X = preflight_data$X,
      y = preflight_data$y,
      k = preflight_k,
      M = big_M,
      time_limit =
        preflight_time_limit
    )
    preflight_rows[[ii]] <- data.frame(
      p = preflight_p,
      k = preflight_k,
      success =
        isTRUE(preflight_fit$success),
      warm_start_added =
        isTRUE(preflight_fit$warm_start_added),
      feasible_incumbent =
        isTRUE(preflight_fit$feasible_incumbent),
      support_size =
        length(preflight_fit$support),
      certified_optimal =
        isTRUE(preflight_fit$certified_optimal),
      status_code =
        if (is.null(preflight_fit$status_code)) {
          NA_integer_
        } else {
          preflight_fit$status_code
        },
      status =
        if (is.null(preflight_fit$status)) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          preflight_fit$status
        },
      error =
        if (is.null(preflight_fit$error)) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          preflight_fit$error
        },
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  preflight_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    preflight_rows
  )
  print(
    preflight_table,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  preflight_ok <- all(
    preflight_table$success &
    preflight_table$warm_start_added &
    preflight_table$feasible_incumbent &
    preflight_table$support_size ==
      preflight_table$k
  )
  if (!preflight_ok) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "CPLEX ALL-K PREFLIGHT FAILED AT p = ",
        preflight_p,
        ". Do not start the Monte Carlo run."
      )
    )
  }
  cat(
    "CPLEX ALL-K PREFLIGHT PASSED AT p =",
    preflight_p,
    "\n"
  )
}
rm(
  preflight_base,
  preflight_data,
  preflight_rows,
  preflight_table,
  preflight_fit
)
gc()
```

```{r}
# Section 15
if (
  file.exists(checkpoint_file) ||
  file.exists(
    paste0(
      checkpoint_file,
      ".bak"
    )
  )
) {
  checkpoint <- read_checkpoint_safely(
    checkpoint_file
  )
  if (
    !identical(
      checkpoint$signature,
      checkpoint_signature
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Existing checkpoint was generated with different",
        "experiment settings. Delete or rename that checkpoint",
        "before running this experiment."
      )
    )
  }
  completed_conditions <-
    checkpoint$completed_conditions
  dgp_diagnostics <-
    checkpoint$dgp_diagnostics
  identification_results <-
    checkpoint$identification_results
  path_results <-
    checkpoint$path_results
  diagnostic_curves <-
    checkpoint$diagnostic_curves
  l0_coverage_results <-
    checkpoint$l0_coverage_results
  abess_gic_audit <-
    checkpoint$abess_gic_audit
  cat(
    "\nCheckpoint loaded successfully.\n"
  )
  cat(
    "Completed conditions:",
    nrow(completed_conditions),
    "\n"
  )
} else {
  completed_conditions <- data.frame(
    rep = integer(0),
    p = integer(0)
  )
  dgp_diagnostics <- data.frame()
  identification_results <- data.frame()
  path_results <- data.frame()
  diagnostic_curves <- data.frame()
  l0_coverage_results <- data.frame()
  abess_gic_audit <- data.frame()
  cat(
    "\nNo checkpoint found. Starting new experiment.\n"
  )
}
experiment_start <- Sys.time()
for (r in seq_len(n_rep)) {
  cat(
    "\n============================================================\n"
  )
  cat(
    "REPLICATION",
    r,
    "OF",
    n_rep,
    "\n"
  )
  cat(
    "============================================================\n"
  )
  base <- generate_replication_base(
    rep_id = r,
    n = n,
    p_min = p_min,
    p_max = p_max,
    rho = rho,
    s_true = s_true,
    beta_min = beta_min,
    beta_max = beta_max,
    target_snr = target_snr,
    master_seed = master_seed
  )
  for (p_current in p_values) {
    already_done <- any(
      completed_conditions$rep == r &
      completed_conditions$p == p_current
    )
    if (already_done) {
      cat(
        "\nSkipping completed condition:",
        "rep =",
        r,
        ", p =",
        p_current,
        "\n"
      )
      next
    }
    cat(
      "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n"
    )
    cat(
      "REP =",
      r,
      "| p =",
      p_current,
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
    )
    data <- make_dimension_dataset(
      base = base,
      p_current = p_current
    )
    condition_dgp <- data.frame(
      rep = r,
      p = p_current,
      n = n,
      s_true = s_true,
      rho = rho,
      target_snr = target_snr,
      population_signal_variance =
        data$population_signal_variance,
      sigma_sq = data$sigma_sq,
      sigma = data$sigma,
      population_snr_check =
        data$population_snr_check,
      realised_snr =
        data$realised_snr,
      true_support =
        paste(
          data$true_support,
          collapse = ","
        ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    cat(
      "True support:",
      paste(
        data$true_support,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "Population SNR check:",
      round(
        data$population_snr_check,
        6
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "Realised sample SNR:",
      round(
        data$realised_snr,
        6
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting CPLEX path...\n"
    )
    cplex_path <- fit_fixed_path(
      method = "CPLEX",
      X = data$X,
      y = data$y,
      k_values = k_values,
      cplex_time_limit =
        cplex_time_limit
    )
    cplex_fit_success <- vapply(
      cplex_path$models,
      function(x) {
        isTRUE(x$success)
      },
      logical(1)
    )
    cplex_start_success <- vapply(
      cplex_path$models,
      function(x) {
        isTRUE(x$warm_start_added)
      },
      logical(1)
    )
    if (
      !all(cplex_fit_success) ||
      !all(cplex_start_success)
    ) {
      failure_dump <- list(
        rep = r,
        p = p_current,
        cplex_path = cplex_path,
        timestamp = Sys.time()
      )
      atomic_save_rds(
        failure_dump,
        file.path(
          output_dir,
          paste0(
            "CPLEX_FAILURE_rep_",
            r,
            "_p_",
            p_current,
            ".rds"
          )
        )
      )
      stop(
        paste0(
          "CPLEX path failed despite the v6 robust CPLEX rule at rep = ",
          r,
          ", p = ",
          p_current,
          ". A failure dump was saved."
        )
      )
    }
    cplex_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path = cplex_path,
      n = n,
      p = p_current,
      required_reference_k = k_max,
      required_k_values = k_values,
      require_complete_path = TRUE,
      ratio_floor = ratio_floor,
      min_left = min_left_points,
      min_right = min_right_points
    )
    condition_identification <-
      diagnostic_identification_rows(
        diagnostic = cplex_diag,
        rep_id = r,
        p_current = p_current,
        method = "CPLEX",
        path_runtime =
          cplex_path$path_runtime
      )
    condition_paths <- path_to_table(
      path = cplex_path,
      rep_id = r,
      p_current = p_current,
      method = "CPLEX"
    )
    condition_curves <- diagnostic_curve_table(
      diagnostic = cplex_diag,
      rep_id = r,
      p_current = p_current,
      method = "CPLEX"
    )
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting COMBSS path...\n"
    )
    combss_path <- fit_fixed_path(
      method = "COMBSS",
      X = data$X,
      y = data$y,
      k_values = k_values
    )
    combss_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path = combss_path,
      n = n,
      p = p_current,
      required_reference_k = k_max,
      required_k_values = k_values,
      require_complete_path = TRUE,
      ratio_floor = ratio_floor,
      min_left = min_left_points,
      min_right = min_right_points
    )
    condition_identification <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_identification,
      diagnostic_identification_rows(
        diagnostic = combss_diag,
        rep_id = r,
        p_current = p_current,
        method = "COMBSS",
        path_runtime =
          combss_path$path_runtime
      )
    )
    condition_paths <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_paths,
      path_to_table(
        path = combss_path,
        rep_id = r,
        p_current = p_current,
        method = "COMBSS"
      )
    )
    condition_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_curves,
      diagnostic_curve_table(
        diagnostic = combss_diag,
        rep_id = r,
        p_current = p_current,
        method = "COMBSS"
      )
    )
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting ABESS path...\n"
    )
    abess_path <- tryCatch(
      {
        fit_abess_path(
          X = data$X,
          y = data$y,
          k_values = k_values
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        list(
          success = FALSE,
          models = NULL,
          path_runtime = NA_real_,
          gic_size_native = NA_integer_,
          gic_size_manual = NA_integer_,
          gic_match = NA,
          error = conditionMessage(e)
        )
      }
    )
    abess_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path = abess_path,
      n = n,
      p = p_current,
      required_reference_k = k_max,
      required_k_values = k_values,
      require_complete_path = TRUE,
      ratio_floor = ratio_floor,
      min_left = min_left_points,
      min_right = min_right_points
    )
    condition_identification <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_identification,
      diagnostic_identification_rows(
        diagnostic = abess_diag,
        rep_id = r,
        p_current = p_current,
        method = "ABESS",
        path_runtime =
          abess_path$path_runtime
      )
    )
    condition_identification <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_identification,
      make_identification_row(
        rep_id = r,
        p_current = p_current,
        method = "ABESS",
        estimator = "GIC",
        s_hat =
          abess_path$gic_size_native,
        path_runtime =
          abess_path$path_runtime,
        reference_k = NA_integer_,
        failure_reason =
          if (
            is.na(
              abess_path$gic_size_native
            )
          ) {
            abess_path$error
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }
      )
    )
    if (!is.null(abess_path$models)) {
      condition_paths <- dplyr::bind_rows(
        condition_paths,
        path_to_table(
          path = abess_path,
          rep_id = r,
          p_current = p_current,
          method = "ABESS"
        )
      )
    }
    condition_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_curves,
      diagnostic_curve_table(
        diagnostic = abess_diag,
        rep_id = r,
        p_current = p_current,
        method = "ABESS"
      )
    )
    condition_gic_audit <- data.frame(
      rep = r,
      p = p_current,
      s_true = s_true,
      native_gic_hat =
        abess_path$gic_size_native,
      manual_gic_hat =
        abess_path$gic_size_manual,
      gic_match =
        abess_path$gic_match,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    cat(
      "\n  Fitting L0Learn native path...\n"
    )
    l0_path <- tryCatch(
      {
        fit_l0learn_path(
          X = data$X,
          y = data$y,
          max_support =
            l0_max_support,
          grid_points =
            l0_grid_points,
          upper_multiplier =
            l0_upper_multiplier,
          lower_multiplier =
            l0_lower_multiplier,
          refine_points_per_gap =
            l0_refine_points_per_gap,
          refine_rounds =
            l0_refine_rounds
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        list(
          success = FALSE,
          models = NULL,
          path_runtime = NA_real_,
          available_sizes = integer(0),
          missing_sizes = k_values,
          number_distinct_sizes = 0L,
          error = conditionMessage(e)
        )
      }
    )
    condition_l0_coverage <- data.frame(
      rep = r,
      p = p_current,
      path_success =
        isTRUE(l0_path$success),
      number_observed_sizes =
        length(
          intersect(
            l0_path$available_sizes,
            k_values
          )
        ),
      observed_sizes =
        paste(
          l0_path$available_sizes,
          collapse = ","
        ),
      missing_sizes =
        paste(
          setdiff(
            k_values,
            l0_path$available_sizes
          ),
          collapse = ","
        ),
      true_size_available =
        s_true %in%
        l0_path$available_sizes,
      reference_size_available =
        k_max %in%
        l0_path$available_sizes,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    cat(
      "    L0Learn observed sizes:",
      paste(
        l0_path$available_sizes,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    l0_diag <- diagnose_model_path(
      path = l0_path,
      n = n,
      p = p_current,
      required_reference_k = k_max,
      required_k_values = k_values,
      require_complete_path = FALSE,
      ratio_floor = ratio_floor,
      min_left = min_left_points,
      min_right = min_right_points
    )
    condition_identification <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_identification,
      diagnostic_identification_rows(
        diagnostic = l0_diag,
        rep_id = r,
        p_current = p_current,
        method = "L0Learn",
        path_runtime =
          l0_path$path_runtime
      )
    )
    if (!is.null(l0_path$models)) {
      condition_paths <- dplyr::bind_rows(
        condition_paths,
        path_to_table(
          path = l0_path,
          rep_id = r,
          p_current = p_current,
          method = "L0Learn"
        )
      )
    }
    condition_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      condition_curves,
      diagnostic_curve_table(
        diagnostic = l0_diag,
        rep_id = r,
        p_current = p_current,
        method = "L0Learn"
      )
    )
    cat(
      "\n  Model-size estimates:\n"
    )
    cplex_number_feasible <- sum(
      vapply(
        cplex_path$models,
        function(x) {
          isTRUE(x$success)
        },
        logical(1)
      )
    )
    cplex_number_certified <- sum(
      vapply(
        cplex_path$models,
        function(x) {
          isTRUE(x$certified_optimal)
        },
        logical(1)
      )
    )
    cat(
      "    CPLEX: Threshold =",
      cplex_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      cplex_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "| Feasible fits =",
      paste0(
        cplex_number_feasible,
        "/",
        length(k_values)
      ),
      "| Certified fits =",
      paste0(
        cplex_number_certified,
        "/",
        length(k_values)
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "    COMBSS: Threshold =",
      combss_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      combss_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "    ABESS: Threshold =",
      abess_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      abess_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "| GIC =",
      abess_path$gic_size_native,
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "    L0Learn: Threshold =",
      l0_diag$threshold_hat,
      "| Breakpoint =",
      l0_diag$piecewise_hat,
      "\n"
    )
    dgp_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      dgp_diagnostics,
      condition_dgp
    )
    identification_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      identification_results,
      condition_identification
    )
    path_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      path_results,
      condition_paths
    )
    diagnostic_curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      diagnostic_curves,
      condition_curves
    )
    l0_coverage_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      l0_coverage_results,
      condition_l0_coverage
    )
    abess_gic_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      abess_gic_audit,
      condition_gic_audit
    )
    completed_conditions <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      completed_conditions,
      data.frame(
        rep = r,
        p = p_current
      )
    )
    checkpoint <- list(
      signature =
        checkpoint_signature,
      target_n_rep =
        n_rep,
      completed_conditions =
        completed_conditions,
      dgp_diagnostics =
        dgp_diagnostics,
      identification_results =
        identification_results,
      path_results =
        path_results,
      diagnostic_curves =
        diagnostic_curves,
      l0_coverage_results =
        l0_coverage_results,
      abess_gic_audit =
        abess_gic_audit
    )
    atomic_save_rds(
      checkpoint,
      checkpoint_file
    )
    cat(
      "\nCheckpoint saved:",
      "rep =",
      r,
      ", p =",
      p_current,
      "\n"
    )
  }
}
experiment_end <- Sys.time()
cat(
  "\n============================================================\n"
)
cat("EXPERIMENT COMPLETE\n")
cat(
  "============================================================\n"
)
cat(
  "Elapsed time in current R session:",
  as.character(
    experiment_end -
      experiment_start
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Completed conditions:",
  nrow(completed_conditions),
  "of",
  n_rep *
    length(p_values),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 17
mean_safe <- function(x) {
  if (
    length(x) == 0 ||
    all(is.na(x))
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  mean(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
median_safe <- function(x) {
  if (
    length(x) == 0 ||
    all(is.na(x))
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  median(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
model_size_summary <- identification_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    p,
    method,
    estimator
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    replications =
      dplyr::n(),
    estimate_availability =
      mean(
        estimate_available,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    correct_identification_rate =
      mean(
        correct,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    correct_given_available =
      if (
        sum(
          estimate_available,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) > 0
      ) {
        mean(
          correct[
            estimate_available
          ],
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
    MAE =
      mean_safe(
        absolute_error
      ),
    Bias =
      mean_safe(
        signed_error
      ),
    mean_estimated_size =
      mean_safe(
        s_hat
      ),
    median_estimated_size =
      median_safe(
        s_hat
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(
  model_size_summary
)
write.csv(
  model_size_summary,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "model_size_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
cplex_status_summary <- path_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    method == "CPLEX"

  dplyr::group_by(
    p,
    k
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      mean(
        warm_start_added,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    certified_rate =
      mean(
        certified_optimal,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    optimal_101_rate =
      mean(
        cplex_status_code == 101L,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    tolerance_optimal_102_rate =
      mean(
        cplex_status_code == 102L,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    time_limit_feasible_107_rate =
      mean(
        cplex_status_code == 107L,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    recovered_3019_rate =
      mean(
        cplex_status_code == -3019L,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    median_runtime =
      median_safe(runtime),
    mean_runtime =
      mean_safe(runtime),
    median_gap =
      median_safe(cplex_gap),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

  cplex_status_summary
)
cplex_dimension_summary <- path_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    method == "CPLEX"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    rep,
    p
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    complete_feasible_path =
      all(success) &&
      dplyr::n_distinct(k) ==
        length(k_values),
    complete_certified_path =
      all(certified_optimal) &&
      dplyr::n_distinct(k) ==
        length(k_values),
    number_certified_fits =
      sum(
        certified_optimal,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    path_runtime =
      dplyr::first(
        path_runtime
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(p) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    complete_feasible_path_rate =
      mean(
        complete_feasible_path,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    complete_certified_path_rate =
      mean(
        complete_certified_path,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    mean_number_certified_fits =
      mean(
        number_certified_fits,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    median_path_runtime =
      median_safe(
        path_runtime
      ),
    mean_path_runtime =
      mean_safe(
        path_runtime
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(
  cplex_dimension_summary
)
```

```{r}
# Section 20
correct_plot_data <- identification_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    p,
    method,
    estimator
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    correct_rate =
      mean(
        correct,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    se =
      sqrt(
        correct_rate *
        (1 - correct_rate) /
        n
      ),
    lower =
      pmax(
        0,
        correct_rate -
        1.96 * se
      ),
    upper =
      pmin(
        1,
        correct_rate +
        1.96 * se
      )
  )
p_correct <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  correct_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = p,
    y = correct_rate,
    group = estimator,
    linetype = estimator,
    shape = estimator
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    width = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~ method
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = p_values
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1)

  ggplot2::labs(
    x =
      "Number of predictors",
    y =
      "Correct model-size identification rate",

      "Estimator",
```

```{r}
    method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    breakpoint_after_k =
      dplyr::first(
        breakpoint_after_k
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(
      breakpoint_after_k
    )
  )
p_example_piecewise <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  example_piecewise_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = k,
    y = log10_ratio
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    ggplot2::aes(
      y =
        piecewise_fit,
      group =
        interaction(
          method,
          piecewise_segment
        )
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    data =
      example_breakpoints,
    ggplot2::aes(
      xintercept =
        breakpoint_after_k +
        0.5
    ),
    linetype =
      "dashed"
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~ method
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks =
      1:(k_max - 1)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x =
      "Candidate model size",
    y =
      expression(
        log[10] * R(k)
      )
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
print(
  p_example_piecewise
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename =
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "example_piecewise_diagnostic_p100.png"
    ),
  plot =
    p_example_piecewise,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# Section 23
```

```{r}
p_availability <- ggplot2::ggplot(
```

```{r}
# Total model-selection path runtime as dimensionality increases
runtime_by_rep <- identification_results %>%
  dplyr::select(
    rep,
    p,
    method,
    path_runtime
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(path_runtime),
    path_runtime > 0
  )
runtime_plot_data <- runtime_by_rep %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    p,
    method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_runtime =
      median(
        path_runtime,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    lower_runtime =
      as.numeric(
        stats::quantile(
          path_runtime,
          probs = 0.25,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      ),
    upper_runtime =
      as.numeric(
        stats::quantile(
          path_runtime,
          probs = 0.75,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
p_runtime <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  runtime_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = p,
    y = median_runtime,
    group = method,
    linetype = method,
    shape = method
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(
      ymin = lower_runtime,
      ymax = upper_runtime
    ),
    width = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = p_values
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_log10() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Number of predictors",
    y = "Total path runtime (seconds)",
    linetype = "Method",
    shape = "Method"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
print(
  p_runtime
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "dimensionality_path_runtime.png"
  ),
  plot = p_runtime,
  width = 8,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# Section 25
expected_conditions <-

  length(p_values)

  "Expected completed conditions:",
  expected_conditions,
  "\n"
)

  "Observed completed conditions:",
  nrow(completed_conditions),
  "\n"
)
if (
  nrow(completed_conditions) !=
  expected_conditions
) {
  warning(
    "The experiment does not contain every expected (rep, p) condition."
  )
}
duplicate_conditions <- completed_conditions %>%
  dplyr::count(
    rep,
    p
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n > 1
  )
if (nrow(duplicate_conditions) > 0) {
  print(
    duplicate_conditions
  )
  stop(
    "Duplicate completed conditions were detected."
  )
}

)
```
